confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge for a mid-sized Japanese regional city; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July demand and Dogo Onsen area pricing vary. Yen-based figures assume roughly 150 JPY per USD from training knowledge, not a verified July 2026 rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional Japanese cities of similar size and tourist profile, such as Takamatsu and Okayama, adjusted for Matsuyama's onsen-driven tourism, which lifts accommodation somewhat.
